questions.q: How do you mark a case as escalated?
o: Tick the Escalated flag and keep the real status
questions.e: Escalated is a flag on top of the status, not a status of its own. The case keeps whatever status genuinely describes where it is, and appears on the Escalated view for daily review.

questions.q: Where do most cases come from?
o: Ops types every one in by hand
They are auto-created from inbound sales@ mail every 15 minutes on weekdays
The salesperson creates them from the Opportunity
They are imported nightly from Intact
questions.e: An automation reads the sales@ mailbox every 15 minutes on weekdays and opens one case per mail thread from a known customer contact, with Received at set to the real arrival time.

questions.q: Which two views should read zero every morning?
o: All Open (SLA) and Resolved — Last 30 Days
Open cases (by status) and the Command Centre
questions.e: Unowned cases means somebody has to claim it; Overdue cases means it has to be cleared or escalated. When both read zero, the queue is under control.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a case type in our CRM?
questions.e: RMA and warranty work is deliberately not a case type. It lives in the Aftercare object as a slim log, because the separate technical system is the source of truth for the detail.
